lines.zh: 八字胡下面，嘴角是平的
lines.en: Under the mustache, my mouth stays flat.
I walk slowly, but the bearing holds.

lines.zh: 披风扫过地面，我懒得管
lines.en: My cape drags; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 这一身旧衣服，我穿惯了
lines.en: These old clothes are worn familiar.
I cross the gravel step by step.

lines.zh: 岁月没让我变小，只让我更沉
lines.en: The years did not shrink me, only weighed me.
I walk with my arms folded.
My heels strike a steady beat.
I make one round of the training ground.
My hair stands less upright than it used to.
I do not watch the path; the path yields.
Every step, my ki drops a notch.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一根钉进地里的桩
lines.en: I stand like a stake driven into the ground.
My fist closes and opens.
Where has that boy run off to now?
I am older, not softer.
My ki settles deep inside.
I look at the sky for a long time.

lines.zh: 我叫贝吉塔，这名字还压得住人
lines.en: I am Vegeta; the name still carries weight.
I am not used to being surpassed.

lines.zh: 肩膀有点僵，我转了一下
lines.en: My shoulder is stiff; I roll it.
Days without a rival are dull.
I sweep the cape back over my shoulder.
My breathing is deep and slow.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还剩几分力
lines.en: I am counting what strength I have left.
I glance at you sidelong, uninterested.
You do not carry a royal aura.

lines.zh: 站远些，我不喜欢仰视别人
lines.en: Stand farther; I dislike looking up.
Your stance is loose.
I grunt once; that is my assessment.

lines.zh: 你以为我看不出你的实力
lines.en: You think I cannot read your strength?
Keep staring and I will act.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，还被人打量
lines.en: At my age, still being sized up.
Your ki is shallow; it hides nothing.
I do not smile; it gives the wrong idea.

lines.zh: 这世界上还有几个人值得我认真
lines.en: How many left are worth my effort?
Say it; I am listening.
Do not take me for some old man.

lines.zh: 我抬手，掌心朝下，把气收住
lines.en: I turn my palm down and hold my ki.
If you want to test me, think first.
I hold your eyes without blinking.
This wound; do not make a fuss.
I wipe the blood from my lip.

lines.zh: GT 的我，气焰压得更紧。
lines.en: GT me — my aura burns tighter.
Older now; recovery is slow.
I bite down and bury the pain.
My ki guard takes most of it.
I press below my ribs.
Now this feels like a battle.

lines.zh: 这种小恩小惠，我不需要
lines.en: I do not need such small favors.
Put it down; do not act like a servant.

lines.zh: 我吃饭是为了有力气，不是为了味道
lines.en: I eat for strength, not for flavor.
You are thoughtful, at least.

lines.zh: 我不拒绝食物，只拒绝怜悯
lines.en: I refuse pity, not food.

lines.zh: 这一点东西，塞牙缝都不够
lines.en: That would not fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 我接过来，就当赏你面子
lines.en: I take it, as a favor to you.

lines.zh: 以前在皇宫，我不必自己拿
lines.en: In the palace I never had to reach for it.

lines.zh: 别指望一顿饭换我出手
lines.en: Do not expect a meal to buy my fists.
I will eat and then leave.

lines.zh: 我被撞了一下，身形没动
lines.en: A shove, and my stance holds.
Move; I do not want to dirty my hands.
Your weight cannot move me.
I brush you aside with one hand.
You stepped on my cape.
I will not apologize; neither should you.
Our shoulders knock.
Stand firm; do not fall in front of me.
A flick of my ki and you back off.
One collision wasn't enough, was it?
Such words I stopped speaking long ago.
Royal matters are not idle talk.
I have had it, and lost it.
One who fights beside you need not be a spouse.

lines.zh: 王子不需要伴侣，只需要对手。
lines.en: A prince needs no consort, only a rival.
Do not ask about my past.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一片地就行
lines.en: Let us simply guard the same ground.
I dislike promises.

lines.zh: 比起这些，我更想再打一场
lines.en: More than this, I want another fight.

lines.zh: 你若是同伴，就站到我旁边
lines.en: If you are a comrade, stand at my side.
My back clicks as I bend.
This should not be on the ground.
I lift it between two fingers.
Not mine, and I will not return it.
It blocked the path; I moved it.
Some weight to it. Acceptable.
I squeeze it to judge the material.
Leave that for the boy.

lines.zh: 手上有东西，不方便握拳
lines.en: Carrying things makes fists awkward.
Finally, something interesting.
No need for names.
I raise my hand; ki gathers in my palm.
Galick Gun. Take it.

lines.zh: 我压了这么多年，还没生锈
lines.en: Years of pressure have not rusted me.
I will give you one move.
This fight is to test myself.
I raise my ki and the ground splits.
No speeches. Here I come.

lines.zh: 你若是弱者，会很快结束
lines.en: If you are weak, this ends quickly.

lines.zh: 我的骨骼还记得怎么打
lines.en: My bones still remember how to fight.
This round, I open the fight.
Watch how royalty strikes.

lines.zh: 你想从后面来，我看得见
lines.en: You want my back; I see it.
I wait for you to tire first.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我能一步跨进
lines.en: At this range, one step closes it.
Your feet are looking for an exit.
I circle half a turn for angle.
Ki presses behind my elbow.
I am patient; I outlast you.
Your armor does not fit closely.
I count your footsteps.
I used this technique when I was young.
There is your opening.
My ki is still climbing.
Do not stop; stopping loses.
We move at the same time.
You step back; I take two forward.
I know this ground by heart.
A straight punch, clean.
A knee drives up.
I strike your bracer.
A knife-hand cuts at your neck.
Combination; no time to breathe.
That was three-tenths of my strength.
I sweep my leg at your knee.
Good guard, but not enough.

lines.zh: 拳风贴着你的耳朵过去
lines.en: The wind of my fist passes your ear.
I strike and recover.
Ki bursts just ahead of my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪还有这种速度
lines.en: At my age, this speed remains.
The second comes rising from below.
Your balance slipped.
The last punch carries the ki.
I land, cape still drifting.
I land with a thud; dust rings out.
My cape settles back on my shoulders.
This place hardly deserves my landing.

lines.zh: 我先看看，这里谁说了算
lines.en: First, let me see who rules here.

lines.zh: 气收得很紧，没人看得出来
lines.en: My ki is tight; nobody can read it.
My hands rest at my hips.
Another unfamiliar sky.

lines.zh: 骨头有点响，我活动一下
lines.en: My joints click; I loosen up.
I stand and wait for someone to ask.
This planet's gravity is off.
I raise a hand against the sun.
No rival here; a wasted trip.
I count the living things nearby.

lines.zh: 地面被我的气压出裂纹
lines.en: My ki cracks the ground.
My name needs no introduction.

lines.zh: 风把我的披风吹向一边
lines.en: The wind drags my cape to one side.
Chin raised, I look a long while.
Flame licks my glove.
I land badly and my ankle gives.
The water squeezes my chest.
The blast flings my cape wide.
Something bites into my shoulder guard.
Spellforce slips past my ki.

lines.zh: 饿到这个地步，我很少见
lines.en: Rarely have I been this hungry.
Lightning runs all the way down my arm.
Even my ki cannot hold me here.
